founded.quote: UbuWeb was founded in November of 1996, initially as a repository for visual, concrete and, later, sound poetry. Over the years, UbuWeb has embraced all forms of the avant-garde and beyond.

volunteer.quote: UbuWeb has no need for funding. All work is done solely on a volunteer basis. Our only cost is our monthly hosting fee, which amounts to US$50 each month.

copyright.quote: The copyrights belong to the copyright holders, not us. You'll need to seek them out for proper permission.

not_for_sale.quote: Nothing is for sale on UbuWeb. It's all free.

policy.quote: If it's out of print, we feel it's fair game. Or if something is in print, yet absurdly priced or insanely hard to procure, we'll take a chance on it. But if it's in print and available to all, we won't touch it.

distribution.quote: UbuWeb functions as a distribution center for hard-to-find, out-of-print and obscure materials, transferred digitally to the web.

removal.quote: Should something return to print, we will remove it from our site immediately. Also, should an artist find their material posted on UbuWeb without permission and wants it removed, please let us know.

permission.quote: Let's face it, if we had to get permission from everyone on UbuWeb, there would be no UbuWeb.

quality.quote: We like poor quality because we believe that an institution or an individual wishing to have the "real" thing should purchase it from those who publish and distribute such materials.

fan_copies.quote: the crappy, say, VHS rips floating around file-sharing site -- where we get much of our material from -- is gorgeously primitive, made by fans.

independent.quote: No. UbuWeb is a completely independent site. However, several universities and partners have generously offered us server space and bandwith, with no restrictions or input regarding our content.

languages.quote: Most of our pages are in English; several of them are not.

editors.quote: Our editors are pretty much spread across the United States: New York City, Utah, California, etc.

email.quote: Due to the volume of email we receive, we unfortunately cannot respond to them all.

commercial_free.quote: UbuWeb is completely commercial-free and it will always stay that way.

archive_not_blog.quote: UbuWeb is an archive, not a blog.

system.quote: coded by hand in BBEdit, all html 1.0. There's no fancy database or back-end.
